detailed_descriptions.en: FEAR OF FAITH is a co-op dieselpunk survival horror game where cloned soldiers raid cursed WWII bunkers to recover SYNTRUM , the essence of those who never returned. Choose from four classes , invoke miracles through FAITH , drink BEER to control your FEAR , and improvise with weapons and physics-based equipment. Explore procedurally generated levels and scavenge everything you need to face a B.O.S.S. that punishes the unprepared. Combine different classes and spells to interact with the environment and overcome obstacles and monsters in unique ways. Ignite oil puddles? Electrify water? Polymorph a GHOUL into a RAT ? Or just cast silent step and sneak through the bunker in total stealth - it all depends on your skill and will. Each class has its own passives and spells. Find the perfect synergy, or form a full priest squad to bring TRUE FAITH into the bunker. Casting spells will consume your FAITH , which causes you to be in FEAR. Some eldritch horrors can drain your FAITH as well, and if you fail to keep it steady, SHE will come for you. Then you will become a GHOUL ... or something worse. Reduce your FEAR with alcohol or ally spells, keep the generator lights on, and buy some COPIUM during the mission. Slowly open doors to check for traps, or kick them open during a chase. Every gameplay item is physical - grab it, throw it, or use it directly from your hands. You can even throw away a grenade triggered by a tripwire . Your teammates can catch items mid-air, BUT DON'T TOSS THEM AN ACTIVE GRENADE! It tends to separate the team. BY LIMBS . Fuel the light to keep FEAR away, or embrace the DARK for greater gain. When the generator is active, it restores your FAITH and slightly tames the monsters - but blocks paths filled with valuable loot . Dive into an alternate World War II era setting, where dieselpunk technology and eldritch horrors collide. Do not FEAR Unreal Engine 5. We kept our FAITH and did our best to optimize it. Any lag is pure HERESY or simply the work of Empire enemies.
